content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Development of an Immersed Boundary Method (IBM) for Granular Flows in OpenFOAM
Rs. 80,000 per month (1st Year) and Rs. 80,000 per month (2nd Year) + HRA as applicable, plus Contingency of Rs. 50,000 per Year

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed a Ph.D. thesis in Mechanical Engineering/Chemical Engineering with a research focus on Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Applicants must possess expertise in gas dynamics, reactive flows, C++ programming, and OpenFOAM-based CFD simulations. Additionally, candidates must have published 2-3 research papers as the first author in SCI-indexed journals, based on their Ph.D. research in compressible flows.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position is full-time and tenable for two years. The fellowship amount is Rs. 80,000 per month plus HRA as applicable for the 1st year and Rs. 80,000 per month plus HRA as applicable for the 2nd year. content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Apart from research activities under the above project, the selected candidate will be entrusted with the following academic and institutional responsibilities: Mentoring UG/PG students. Participating in research discussions. Engaging in other activities as deemed fit by the mentor (Prof. Ankit Bansal).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Access the official application link via the designated Google Form. Submit your academic details, including Ph.D. information. Complete and submit the Google Form on or before 28 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on eligibility and suitability for the position. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview, and final selection will be made based on the overall assessment. Submission of the Google Form does not guarantee selection, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under notification MIED/PDF/2141?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application is 28 October 2026 (Wednesday).

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for this Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a Ph.D. thesis in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a research focus on Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), along with expertise in gas dynamics, reactive flows, C++ programming, OpenFOAM-based CFD simulations, and 2-3 first-author papers in SCI-indexed journals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?

faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can eligible candidates apply for the position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by submitting their academic details, including Ph.D. information, through the provided Google Form.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on eligibility and suitability, and final selection is made through an interview for shortlisted candidates based on overall assessment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or fellowship amount for the Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 80,000 per month plus HRA as applicable for both the 1st and 2nd years, along with a contingency of Rs. 50,000 per year.

faq.question: Q9. Is this position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position is purely temporary and full-time for a tenure of two years.
